scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@newsgarden/shared && npm run build --workspace=newsgarden-backend && npm run build --workspace=newsgarden-frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=newsgarden-backend" "npm run dev --workspace=newsgarden-frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@newsgarden/shared --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
